title: Phrases: formal emails
description: Frasi pronte per le mail formali

cards.back: Dear Sir or Madam, (closing: Yours faithfully)
cards.example: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing regarding our integration request.

cards.back: I am writing regarding...
cards.example: I am writing regarding the reconciliation discrepancies from last week.

cards.back: Following our call earlier today, ...
cards.example: Following our call earlier today, please find the summary below.

cards.back: Thank you for your reply.
cards.example: Thank you for your reply and for the updated file specification.

cards.back: Thank you for getting back to me so quickly.
cards.example: Thank you for getting back to me so quickly on the incident.

cards.back: Please find attached...
cards.example: Please find attached the signed data processing agreement.

cards.back: As requested, ...
cards.example: As requested, I have included the API logs for Monday.

cards.back: As agreed, ...
cards.example: As agreed, we will deploy the fix on Thursday evening.

cards.back: I would be grateful if you could...
cards.example: I would be grateful if you could confirm the new cut-off time.

cards.back: Could you please confirm...?
cards.example: Could you please confirm whether the file was received?

cards.back: Please let me know if...
cards.example: Please let me know if you need any further information.

cards.back: Please do not hesitate to contact me with any questions.
cards.example: Please do not hesitate to contact me with any questions about the release.

cards.front: In attesa di un suo riscontro
cards.back: I look forward to hearing from you.
cards.example: I look forward to hearing from you regarding the test schedule.

cards.front: Mi scuso per il ritardo nella risposta
cards.back: Apologies for the delay in getting back to you.
cards.example: Apologies for the delay in getting back to you on the audit.

cards.back: We apologise for any inconvenience caused.
cards.example: We apologise for any inconvenience caused by yesterday's outage.

cards.back: We regret to inform you that...
cards.example: We regret to inform you that the release has been postponed.

cards.back: We are pleased to inform you that...
cards.example: We are pleased to inform you that the migration is complete.

cards.back: Just a gentle reminder that...
cards.example: Just a gentle reminder that the certificate expires on Friday.

cards.front: Sollecito: non ho ancora ricevuto risposta
cards.back: I am following up on my email of 3 March.
cards.example: I am following up on my email of 3 March about the API keys.

cards.back: I would appreciate your urgent attention to this matter.
cards.example: I would appreciate your urgent attention to this matter, as clients are affected.

cards.back: I've copied in my colleague, who leads the project.
cards.example: I've copied in my colleague, who leads the onboarding project.

cards.back: Adding the PM to this thread.
cards.example: Adding the PM to this thread for visibility on the timeline.

cards.back: I'm forwarding you the email from...
cards.example: I'm forwarding you the email from the vendor about pricing.

cards.back: I would like to clarify one point.
cards.example: I would like to clarify one point regarding the data retention policy.

cards.back: Could you clarify whether...?
cards.example: Could you clarify whether the change also affects existing contracts?

cards.back: I'd suggest a short call to discuss this.
cards.example: I'd suggest a short call to discuss this before the deadline.

cards.back: When would suit you?
cards.example: When would suit you for a thirty-minute technical review?

cards.back: That works for me.
cards.example: That works for me. I'll send an invitation for Tuesday.

cards.back: Would it be possible to reschedule the meeting?
cards.example: Would it be possible to reschedule the meeting to Thursday morning?

cards.back: Please see the next steps below.
cards.example: Please see the next steps below and let me know of any concerns.

cards.back: To summarise, ...
cards.example: To summarise, the issue was caused by an expired certificate.

cards.front: Purtroppo non siamo in grado di...
cards.back: Unfortunately, we are unable to...
cards.example: Unfortunately, we are unable to meet the original deadline.

cards.back: I'm afraid that...
cards.example: I'm afraid that the fix will not be ready this week.

cards.back: We have identified the root cause.
cards.example: We have identified the root cause and a fix is in progress.

cards.back: We will keep you updated on progress.
cards.example: We will keep you updated on progress throughout the day.

cards.back: Please note that...
cards.example: Please note that the service will be unavailable on Sunday.

cards.back: I am writing on behalf of...
cards.example: I am writing on behalf of the architecture team.

cards.back: Many thanks in advance for your help.
cards.example: Many thanks in advance for your help with the test data.

cards.back: Kind regards,
cards.example: Thank you again for your support. Kind regards,

cards.back: Best wishes, / Best,
cards.example: Best wishes, and have a good weekend ahead of the release.
